page.overview:
Who is J. Low Lee?

J. Low Lee is a Piston Cup fan who supports Strip Weathers. He is a small car with a blue livery and chrome rims.

In Cars, Lee attends the tie-breaker race between Lightning McQueen, Chick Hicks, and Strip Weathers at the Los Angeles International Speedway. Prior to the race, Lee and many others crowd around Bob Cutlass and Darrell Cartrip as they are being recorded near the entrance gate by the Racing Sports Network.
